name: @spier/guide
description: SPiER's Adoption Guide Worker — the guide SPA and the rendered HL7 IG over Static Assets. The CDS Hooks API moved to services/cds on 2026-09-20, which is why this no longer imports the catalog and its verify is offline.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run stage:assets && npm run build:worker
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run stage:assets && npm run build:worker && wrangler dev
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:csp && npm run test
